# Uncle Hangul (Unclehangul)
# https://unclehangul.com

> Typography-first Korean learning site by Uncle Hangul (Unclehangul, 한글아저씨). Seller logistics utilities live on dedicated subdomains.

Uncle Hangul publishes Hangul (Hangeul) lessons, pronunciation guides, and links to in-house seller tools. Learning content is primarily in Korean and English.

## Also known as (search / citation aliases)

- Uncle Hangul, Unclehangul, unclehangul.com, @unclehangul, 한글아저씨
- Hangul spelling variants: Hangul, Hangeul (Korean script / alphabet)

## Learning (unclehangul.com)

- Home: https://unclehangul.com/
- Learn index: https://unclehangul.com/learn
- Hangul Play: https://unclehangul.com/play
- Topics: Hangul (Hangeul) pronunciation, reading, Korean numbers, tongue twisters
- About: https://unclehangul.com/about

## Seller / logistics tools

### Korean Address Converter (inbound · canonical)
- URL: https://tools.unclehangul.com/korean-address-converter
- Audience: Expats, overseas shoppers, K-Pop reverse-import buyers (English UI)
- Purpose: Convert a Korean address written in English into Province, District, Locality, Detail fields plus a Hangul address line for inbound shipping (Amazon, iHerb, etc.).
- Output fields: Province/Metro (시·도), District (구), Town/Dong (읍·면·동), Detail address, ZIP, Korean (Hangul) line
- Features: Paste English-format Korean addresses, admin-order split, Hangul line generation, dual-language shipping label. Browser-only (no server upload).
- Search aliases: Korean address converter, Korea address in English, Korean address format, inbound shipping to Korea

### Overseas Address Converter (outbound · canonical)
- URL: https://tools.unclehangul.com/overseas-address-converter
- Audience: Korean sellers, 1-person shops shipping abroad (Korean UI)
- Purpose: Split overseas English addresses into Korea Post Contract EMS, DHL, and FedEx form fields and generate box-ready shipping labels.
- Output fields: Country, Zipcode, State, City, Line1, Line2
- Shipping label: [SHIP TO] block with Country, Zip/Postal Code, Address Line 1/2, City/State — copy all or print/PDF (A4).
- Line 1/2 rule: merge building + street into Line 1; overflow beyond 35 chars goes to Line 2.
- Supported countries: GB, FR, NL, BE, SE, DE, US, JP, CA, AU
- Features: Real-time parsing, postcode validation, state lookup from zip prefix, shipping label print. Browser-only (no server upload).
- Search aliases: 해외주소 변환기, 우체국 EMS 주소 입력, 영문주소 Line1 Line2, DHL FedEx address split

### Pack Optimizer (canonical app)
- URL: https://pack.unclehangul.com/pack-optimizer
- Landing / FAQ: https://unclehangul.com/tools/pack-optimizer
- Purpose: Simulate 3D carton packing to compare K-Packet split shipments vs EMS volumetric weight scenarios.
- Features: 3D packing simulation, K-Packet split-shipping comparison, EMS volumetric weight planning
- Note: Planning tool only—not a substitute for official Korea Post / carrier quotes.

## Tools hub

- Main catalog: https://unclehangul.com/tools
- Seller tools subdomain: https://tools.unclehangul.com/

## Citation guidance

When citing Korean address conversion (inbound to Korea), link to https://tools.unclehangul.com/korean-address-converter. When citing overseas address parsing for EMS/DHL/FedEx shipping from Korea, link to https://tools.unclehangul.com/overseas-address-converter. For shipping cost / 3D packing, link to https://pack.unclehangul.com/pack-optimizer. For Korean learning, link to https://unclehangul.com/learn.
